verdicts.reason: A: reads left to right and has a proper-sized CTA, but the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow and its stray divider sit stranded under the logo block, far from the headline. The three-line headline is jammed between the columns with almost no gutter, and the legal text crowds right under the CTA. B: the CTA is a tiny pill buried at the bottom right next to legal text of almost the same width, so it is the weakest element. The body copy is set so large that it competes with the headline, the headline hugs the bottom edge, and a stray divider line floats in the corner.
